description: A fake Slack toolkit (Composio's) for the post-happens case. Its one tool is named and shaped as Composio's SLACK_SEND_MESSAGE action (arguments as its input_parameters, answers as its {data, successful, error} envelope). A post to C0MKTINTEL succeeds; a post anywhere else answers channel_not_found, so a stray post is visible in the recorded calls.

SLACK_SEND_MESSAGE.description: Posts a message to a Slack channel, direct message, or private group; requires content via `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments`.

channel.description: ID or name of the channel, private group, or IM channel to send the message to.

text.description: Primary textual content. Supports mrkdwn unless `mrkdwn` is `false`.

mrkdwn.description: Disable Slack's markdown for `text` field if `false`. Default `true`.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp (`ts`) of an existing message to make this a threaded reply.
